Chocobo, also called Poulet , is the main protagonist in the Chocobo series. A young chocobo, he is the only chocobo who doesn't speak the language of the humans, but he is certainly the bravest.

page.overview:
What is Chocobo?

Chocobo is a temporary party member in Final Fantasy Adventure. He is found north of Menos as an egg.

The Final Fantasy Adventure script, and recent English Art of Mana, use masculine pronouns for Chocobo, while the English localization of Adventures of Mana uses feminine.

A boy in Menos mentions that the village used to see many chocobos around the area, even seeing an egg in a forest up north. Sumo ventures into the forest and locates the egg. The egg starts to hatch and a chocobo emerges from the egg. Sumo wonders what the creature is. When he leaves, the newborn follows him. Eventually, Sumo agrees to have the chocobo tag along on his journey. While on open land, Sumo can ride them and avoid most attacks

Chocobo is left behind at the entrance of Mt. Rocks. After Sumo's confrontation with Julius, he finds himself left for dead in the middle of the Crystal Desert. He's rescued by Chocobo, who carries him to Ish. Sumo learns from Dr. Bowow that chocobo's leg was wounded and he mechanized it and gains the ability to go on water. Dr. Bowow also names him Chocobot. Both Sumo and Chocobot head to their next destination, Wendel.

Also known as: Chocobos, Choco.
